formId: system-provider-composition-v1
title: "Provider"
# Merges the 7 formerly-separate clinic-management forms (system-hospital-profile-v1,
# system-locations-profile-v1, system-staff-profile-v1, system-services-profile-v1,
# system-office-hours-profile-v1, system-consents-profile-v1, system-appointments-profile-v1)
# into one Organization-anchored composition — the clinic-management-side mirror of
# system-encounter-composition-v1.yaml's Patient-side merge. Organization MUST stay
# composition[0] — yaml-to-questionnaire.js derives subjectType only from
# composition[0].resourceType, same hard constraint as the Encounter file.
#
# Administrator is deliberately NOT its own block here — it stays a staff_role choice value
# (confirmed decision, not an oversight) since it has no fields distinct from Staff today.
#
# Hospital's own 3 ABDM sub-blocks (facility-type/location/registration) stay separate,
# non-repeating blocks rather than being collapsed into section_hospital — Hospital never
# repeats, so there's no correspondence-across-instances risk the way there would be for Staff
# (see below), and keeping them separate minimizes changes to the already-delicate ABDM
# registration field set.
#
# Staff's 3 former blocks (core/PractitionerRole/ABDM-registration) ARE collapsed into one
# section_staff block, repeats:true — collapsing is required here: if core/role/ABDM-
# registration stayed 3 independently-repeating sibling blocks, instance N of "core" would have
# no guaranteed correspondence to instance N of "role" for the same staff member once there's
# more than one. Each field keeps its original, accurate FHIR path even though they now share
# one block.
composition:
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital
    label: "Hospital Details"
    # Layout for clinux-frontend's QuestionnaireForm renderer (was hand-coded in FacilityBasicsHost.vue).
    sections:
      - { id: basics, label: "Basics", icon: "fa-hospital" }
      - { id: address, label: "Address", icon: "fa-location-dot" }
      - { id: contact, label: "Contact", icon: "fa-phone" }
    fields:
      # Organization.active (min 1 in ClinuxFlowFacility). Defined ONCE, here: it used to appear
      # twice in section_hospital_abdm_facility_type (a duplicate linkId, invalid in a FHIR
      # Questionnaire) while FacilityBasicsHost.vue stored it under section_hospital.
      - id: "hospital_operational_status"
        section: basics
        path: "Organization.active"
        label: "Currently Operational"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      - id: "hospital_name"
        section: basics
        path: "Organization.name"
        label: "Hospital Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "hospital_legalname"
        section: basics
        path: "Organization.alias"
        label: "Legal / Trade Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Labeled "Facility Category" (not "Facility Type") to avoid colliding with ABDM
      # Registration's own hospital_facility_type below — same field name, different meaning,
      # found as a real naming collision live.
      - id: "hospital_type"
        section: basics
        path: "Organization.type"
        label: "Facility Category"
        uiComponent: "Dropdown"
        choices: ["Hospital","Clinic","Pharmacy","Laboratory","Imaging Centre"]
      - id: "hospital_npi"
        section: basics
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "NPI / Registration No."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24 real gap found via a live pipeline run against ClinuxFlowFacility.json: this was
      # Organization.address.text (a free-text blob, real FHIR but not what the profile
      # constrains) — the profile requires Organization.address.line (1..2, matching HFR's own
      # addressLine1 Required + addressLine2 optional), which nothing here ever wrote to, so no
      # facility could validate no matter how completely this field was filled in. Retargeted;
      # .text was never a distinct field elsewhere, so this is a rename, not new data loss.
      - id: "hospital_address"
        section: address
        path: "Organization.address.line"
        label: "Street Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_city"
        section: address
        path: "Organization.address.city"
        label: "City"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_state"
        section: address
        path: "Organization.address.state"
        label: "State"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pin"
        section: address
        path: "Organization.address.postalCode"
        label: "PIN Code"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_country"
        section: address
        path: "Organization.address.country"
        label: "Country"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_phone"
        section: contact
        widget: tel
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Primary Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_whatsapp"
        section: contact
        widget: tel
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "WhatsApp Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_email"
        section: contact
        widget: email
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Email Address"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_website"
        section: contact
        widget: url
        path: "Organization.telecom.value"
        label: "Website URL"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  # UPDATE — real FHIR-native onboarding rebuild: ABDM's own field requirements (verified against
  # abdmAdapter.js's real gateway request bodies — every field referenced there, e.g.
  # buildHfrBasicInfoBody's ownershipCode/facilityType/facilitySubType/stateLGDCode/... — is
  # captured somewhere in this file already; "keep the ABDM fields as reference for minimal
  # completeness" confirmed no NEW fields were needed, just correct FHIR homes for them) are HFR
  # registry CODES, not general clinical/demographic data — none of them are a good semantic fit
  # for the generic paths they used before (Organization.type meant for a CodeableConcept
  # classification, Organization.identifier.value meant for a business identifier, not
  # registration-process metadata). "any field not found in the FHIR spec needed for ABDM capture
  # goes into extension fields" (explicit instruction) — moved to real, distinctly-URLed
  # Organization.extension entries instead. hospital_operational_status (Organization.active) and
  # hospital_facility_id/hospital_npi (Organization.identifier.value) are UNCHANGED — those ARE
  # already good, standard FHIR fits, not touched.
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_facility_type
    label: "Facility Type & Ownership"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_ownership_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-ownership-code"
        label: "Ownership Code (HFR master: OWNER)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_type"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-facility-type"
        label: "Facility Type Code (HFR master: facility-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_subtype"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-facility-subtype"
        label: "Facility Sub-Type Code (HFR master: facility-sub-types)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24 real gap found while wiring conformance-validator.js against real captured data,
      # not while reading the YAML in isolation: ClinuxFlowFacility.json (data/structure-
      # definitions) requires ownershipSubTypeCode/systemOfMedicine/geoLatitude/geoLongitude
      # (min:1 each) — see New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf's own get-owner-subtype and
      # facility-registration field tables — but no field on this form ever captured them; a
      # facility could never validate, full stop, no matter how completely both onboarding pages
      # were filled in. ownershipSubTypeCode is a master-data code exactly like ownershipCode
      # above it (real TextInput per HFR's own get-owner-subtype API, not a static local list).
      - id: "hospital_ownership_subtype_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-ownership-subtype-code"
        label: "Ownership Sub-Type Code (HFR master: get-owner-subtype)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Real, standard AYUSH + Modern-Medicine/Dentistry categories, confirmed against
      # New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf's own worked samples (systemOfMedicineCode "M,D" =
      # Modern Medicine + Dentistry, "UN,H" = Unani + Homeopathy) — HFR itself wants these as one
      # comma-joined code string on the wire, but ClinuxFlowFacility.json's own comment is explicit
      # that this profile models it as a real repeating extension, not a comma-joined string;
      # MultiSelect already writes one array slot per selection (same mechanism staff_specialty
      # above and hours_days below already use, and the one local-extractor.js MultiSelect bug —
      # answers truncated to the first choice — is already fixed).
      - id: "hospital_system_of_medicine"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-system-of-medicine"
        label: "System(s) of Medicine (HFR master: MEDICINE)"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Modern Medicine (Allopathy)", "Ayurveda", "Homeopathy", "Unani", "Siddha", "Yoga & Naturopathy", "Dentistry"]
      # UPDATE — real bug found live via a full end-to-end pipeline test, not caught by reading
      # the YAML alone: this was `uiComponent: Dropdown` with 2 string choices, but
      # Organization.active is genuinely a FHIR boolean — the compiler maps Dropdown to a
      # `choice`-type item regardless of the target path, and nothing converts the string answer
      # "Functional"/"Non-Functional" into a real true/false, so extraction produced
      # `active: "Functional"` — structurally invalid for a real boolean field. staff_status
      # (Practitioner.active, right below in section_staff) already used Checkbox correctly; this
      # one didn't, inconsistently. Fixed at the authoring level, not by adding string->boolean
      # coercion to the extractor — a boolean concept should be captured as a real boolean.
      # SPEC-24 real gap found the same way as ownership-subtype/system-of-medicine/geo above:
      # HFR's own CODED operational-status value (get-master-data type='FAC-STATUS') is a real,
      # required, distinct field from Organization.active above — active is this profile's own
      # derived boolean for internal use (see ClinuxFlowFacility.json's own comment on this exact
      # distinction); this extension round-trips HFR's richer status code untouched. Never
      # captured before this.
      - id: "hospital_operational_status_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-operational-status-code"
        label: "Operational Status Code (HFR master: FAC-STATUS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Real fields found missing while grounding FacilityHfrPanel.vue's basic-information body
      # against New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf §2.1's own real sample request (read directly,
      # not guessed) — ownershipSubTypeCode2 is a SECOND, distinct ownership sub-type code
      # (PP01/PN01-style, HFR master PROFIT-TYPE/NON-PROFIT-TYPE — confirmed reliably fetchable
      # live, unlike get-owner-subtype/facility-types/facility-sub-types which are all returning
      # real HIS-500s on the sandbox as of this build), separate from
      # hospital_ownership_subtype_code above it (that one stays TextInput — its own master data
      # source is one of the broken ones).
      - id: "hospital_ownership_subtype_code_2"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-ownership-subtype-code-2"
        label: "Ownership Sub-Type Code 2 (HFR master: PROFIT-TYPE / NON-PROFIT-TYPE)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_type_of_service_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-type-of-service-code"
        label: "Type of Service (HFR master: TYPE-SERVICE)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_speciality_type_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-speciality-type-code"
        label: "Speciality Type (Single or Multiple)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_facility_region"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-facility-region"
        label: "Facility Region (U = Urban, R = Rural)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Additional Information API's own hasX general-information flags (New_HFR_APIs_Documentation
      # _SBX.pdf §2.2). UPDATE — real bug found and fixed while building the Detailed Information
      # follow-up: these are NOT plain Y/N booleans (Checkbox was wrong) — the doc's own real
      # sample uses "YALL" (Yes, available for everyone), confirmed live against get-master-data
      # type='GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS' (3 real codes: YALL/YIN/N). TextInput (a coded value, captured
      # by a hand-authored panel dropdown — see FacilityHfrPanel.vue), not Checkbox.
      - id: "hospital_has_dialysis_center"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-dialysis-center"
        label: "Has Dialysis Center (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_has_pharmacy"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-pharmacy"
        label: "Has Pharmacy (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_has_blood_bank"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-blood-bank"
        label: "Has Blood Bank (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_has_cath_lab"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-cath-lab"
        label: "Has Cath Lab (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_has_diagnostic_lab"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-diagnostic-lab"
        label: "Has Diagnostic Lab (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_has_imaging_center"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-has-imaging-center"
        label: "Has Imaging Center (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

      # --- Detailed Information API's own conditional sections (New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf
      # §2.3) — only required/sent when the corresponding hasX flag above is YALL/YIN, per the
      # doc's own error-response sample (sending an irrelevant section is REJECTED, not ignored).
      # FacilityHfrPanel.vue shows each of these conditionally.
      - id: "hospital_pharmacy_jan_aushadhi"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-pharmacy-jan-aushadhi"
        label: "Is Jan Aushadhi Kendra (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pharmacy_jan_aushadhi_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-pharmacy-jan-aushadhi-id"
        label: "Jan Aushadhi Kendra ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pharmacy_drug_license"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-pharmacy-drug-license"
        label: "Pharmacy Drug License Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pharmacy_gstin"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-pharmacy-gstin"
        label: "Pharmacy GSTIN Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_pharmacist_registration"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-pharmacist-registration"
        label: "Pharmacist Registration Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_bloodbank_eraktkosh"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-bloodbank-eraktkosh"
        label: "Registered in e-Raktkosh (HFR master: GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_bloodbank_eraktkosh_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-bloodbank-eraktkosh-id"
        label: "e-Raktkosh ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_bloodbank_license"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-bloodbank-license"
        label: "Blood Bank License Number"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_imaging_services"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-imaging-services"
        label: "Imaging Services Offered (HFR master: IMAGING)"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["X-Ray", "CT-Scan", "MRI(Magnetic Resonance Imaging)", "Ultrasonography(USG)", "ColorDoppler"]
      - id: "hospital_diagnostic_services"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-diagnostic-services"
        label: "Diagnostic Lab Services Offered (HFR master: DIAGNOSTIC)"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Pathology", "Haematology", "Cytology", "Microbiology", "Serology", "Biochemistry", "Histopathology", "Genetics", "Virology", "Cytopathology", "MolecularBiology", "Toxicology", "OralPathology"]
      - id: "hospital_total_beds"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-total-beds"
        label: "Total Number of Beds"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_dental_chairs"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-dental-chairs"
        label: "Number of Dental Chairs"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Detailed Information's own real specialities[] field (per system of medicine) — codes are
      # self-describing which system they belong to (e.g. "M-S1" -> system "M"), so one flat
      # multi-value field is enough; FacilityHfrPanel.vue groups by prefix when building the real
      # request body. Live-fetched (HFR master: get-specialities, per system of medicine actually
      # selected) same as imaging/diagnostic services above — choices here is a placeholder for
      # the compiler, same as those two already establish; the real UI never reads it.
      - id: "hospital_specialities"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-specialities"
        label: "Specialities / Services Offered (HFR master: SPECIALITIES)"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["General Medicine", "Family Medicine", "Emergency Medicine", "Pediatrics", "General Surgery"]

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_location
    label: "ABDM Location (LGD Codes)"
    fields:
      # UPDATE — real bug this fix also closes: district_lgd_code and subdistrict_lgd_code both
      # mapped to the SAME Organization.address.district path before — with the real array-
      # cardinality fix (local-extractor.js's FHIR_ARRAY_PATHS), two fields sharing one leaf path
      # now correctly get separate array slots, which for Organization.address (itself an array)
      # would have split them into TWO DIFFERENT address entries instead of describing the SAME
      # one facility address — a real, different bug the extension move avoids entirely, not just
      # the "not really a FHIR-standard field" concern this section is otherwise about.
      - id: "hospital_state_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-state-lgd-code"
        label: "State LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/states)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_district_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-district-lgd-code"
        label: "District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/districts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_subdistrict_lgd_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-subdistrict-lgd-code"
        label: "Sub-District LGD Code (HFR master: lgd/subdistricts)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # SPEC-24: the other half of the same real gap noted above hospital_ownership_subtype_code
      # — ClinuxFlowFacility.json requires geoLatitude/geoLongitude (HFR: latitude/longitude,
      # Required, "-90.000000 to +90.000000"/"-180.000000 to +180.000000") but this form never
      # captured them. TextInput, not a number field — HFR's own docs specify these as strings.
      - id: "hospital_geo_latitude"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-geolocation-latitude"
        label: "Latitude"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_geo_longitude"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-geolocation-longitude"
        label: "Longitude"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_hospital_abdm_registration
    label: "ABDM Facility Registration"
    fields:
      - id: "hospital_tracking_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-tracking-id"
        label: "Tracking ID (from Basic Information step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # hospital_facility_id stays a real Organization.identifier — the ABDM-ASSIGNED facility id,
      # once registration completes, is a genuine business identifier for this Organization (same
      # reasoning hospital_npi already used), not registration-process metadata.
      - id: "hospital_facility_id"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "ABDM Facility ID (from Submit step)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Real, pre-existing gap found while rebuilding FacilityHfrPanel.vue's UX: rebuildFromRecord()
      # used to infer the whole journey's stage from trackingId/facilityId alone, so reloading the
      # page after Additional/Detailed Information succeeded (but before Submit) silently forgot
      # that progress — the ledger would show those stages as re-doable instead of done. These two
      # booleans are the fix: real, minimal "did this real API call already succeed" markers.
      - id: "hospital_additional_info_submitted"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-additional-info-submitted"
        label: "Additional Information submitted"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      - id: "hospital_detailed_info_submitted"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-detailed-info-submitted"
        label: "Detailed Information submitted"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      - id: "hospital_abdm_software_code"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-software-code"
        label: "ABDM-Compliant Software Code (get-Software-details master)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_of_information"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-source-of-information"
        label: "Source of Information"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_source_unique_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-source-unique-id"
        label: "Source Unique ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      # Linked Program IDs — the manual's own step 10 ("if you have any program linked such as
      # NIN, PMJAY, NHRR etc."). All genuinely optional national-scheme identifiers; abdmAdapter.js's
      # linkedProgramIds request-body shape already existed but read hardcoded '' for every one of
      # these — this is what makes that shape real instead of always-empty.
      # NOTE: this set matches the real linkedProgramIds API body (7 fields + ceaRegistration),
      # not a literal transcription of the manual's own screenshot — the manual shows "State HMIS
      # ID" where the real Additional Information API has no matching key at all (State HMIS is
      # instead the SUBMIT API's own single sourceOfInformation/sourceUniqueID pair, already
      # captured via hospital_source_of_information/hospital_source_unique_id above, and correctly
      # left empty for a self-registering facility per buildHfrSubmitBody's own header comment —
      # it's a closed-set code for bulk-MIGRATED records, not a parallel identifier). Conversely
      # the real API has a ceaRegistration slot the manual's screenshot never shows at all — kept,
      # since matching the real API a self-registering facility actually submits to is worth more
      # than matching a partially-cropped screenshot.
      - id: "hospital_linked_nhrr_id"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-linked-nhrr-id"
        label: "NHRR ID"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_linked_nin"
        path: "Organization.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hfr-linked-nin"
        label: "National Identification Number (NIN)"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "hospital_linked_rohini_id"

  # facility) as a genuinely separate FHIR resource from Practitioner (the person), so one person
  # can later hold roles at more than one facility — the split ClinuxFlowProviderRole.json is
  # built against. A SIBLING top-level block, not nested inside section_staff above: nesting a
  # DIFFERENT resourceType's fields inside a repeating group compiles clean through
  # local-extractor.js (confirmed, and fixed a real cross-resourceType instance-clobbering bug
  # doing so) but NOT through yaml-to-questionnaire.js's own schema/dictionary validation, which
  # ties every field in a block — nested or not — to that ONE block's own declared resourceType;
  # a bare resource-type name like "PractitionerRole" is not a real field PATH within Practitioner
  # for that check to accept. Teaching the compiler a per-group resourceType override is a real,
  # separate piece of work, not bundled into this pass. A sibling block needs no compiler change
  # at all and is exactly the existing, already-proven pattern (section_hospital/section_staff/...
  # are already siblings, each its own resourceType) — the only real requirement it adds is that
  # the SAVE flow appends one section_staff instance and one section_staff_role instance together,
  # always in lockstep (hand-guaranteed by ProviderBasicsHost.vue's own merge logic, not LForms'
  # independent per-group "+ Add Another") — local-extractor.js's own separate-instances counter
  # is a simple running count per group linkId, so matching append order is what keeps the Nth
  # repetition of each block correctly correlated to the same real staff member.
  #
  # PractitionerRole.practitioner/.organization are NOT fields here — both get auto-linked by
  # local-extractor.js (matching this SAME repetition's own Practitioner, and the one Organization
  # in this record) once both resources exist in the same extraction — no manual reference field
  # needed, same as it already worked for the single-Practitioner case.
  - resourceType: PractitionerRole
    id: section_staff_role
    label: "Role at this Facility"
    repeats: true
    fields:
      - id: "staff_role_active"
        path: "PractitionerRole.active"
        label: "Currently Active in this Role"
        uiComponent: "Checkbox"
      # Real HPR role codes confirmed against "1. Register Healthcare Professional (Doctor & Nurse)
      # API.pdf"'s own Roles table (1/2/3) — this WAS staff_abdm_role on Practitioner.extension
      # with invented Doctor/Nurse/Facility Manager choices, conflating the SEPARATE
      # hpCategoryCode concept above with the real HPR role table; ClinuxFlowProviderRole.json's
      # own comment already reconciles the prior YAML's "Administrator" concept as really being
      # HPR's own "Facility Manager" role. Retargeted here, not duplicated.
      # Role vs entitlement: the HPR role (1/2/3 — what this person may do at the facility, e.g.
      # manage it) is an ENTITLEMENT source, not their profession, so it lives in its own
      # extension. PractitionerRole.code carries the professional role as SNOMED CT (as the ABDM
      # IG binds it), derived from staff_hp_category_code by data/ig-conformance.json's
      # professionalRoles map in local-extractor.js.
      - id: "staff_provider_role"
        path: "PractitionerRole.extension"
        extensionUrl: "https://clinux.yaxb.ai/fhir/StructureDefinition/hpr-role"
        label: "HPR Role (HPR master: role)"

      # Staff can be associated with more than one branch (design call — real for a multi-branch
      # clinic's shared staff) — real FHIR PractitionerRole.location is genuinely 0..*, unlike
      # HealthcareService.location's single-branch case above. Same index-correlation/deferred-
      # resolution mechanism, MultiSelect submits one answer per chosen branch and
      # local-extractor.js already extracts every MultiSelect answer (not just the first — see its
      # own header comment on that fix), so no change beyond refTo was needed to support the ×N
      # case with the exact same code path as the single-value one.
      - id: "staff_location_ids"
        path: "PractitionerRole.location"
        label: "Branches"
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        refTo: "Location"

  # relationship (a partner imaging centre/lab/billing service delivering a shared service to/

  # definitions), FHIR R4's own OrganizationAffiliation resource, not a repurposed Organization.

  # WHOLE compiler pipeline already uses for every Reference/CodeableConcept leaf (a bare value,

  # path (Reference is treated as opaque/unwalked here, unlike identifier's own richer sub-tree),

  # real CodeableConcept-array paths — MultiSelect's own multi-answer handling (local-extractor
  # .js's dynamicArrayIndexTrackingLedger) gives each its own array slot, matching HealthcareService

  # `.healthcareService` (which of THIS facility's own HealthcareService entries the affiliate

  - resourceType: OrganizationAffiliation

        choices: ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Radiology", "Pediatrics", "Orthopedics", "Dermatology", "General Medicine", "ENT", "Ophthalmology", "Psychiatry"]
      - id: "affiliate_org_phone"
        path: "OrganizationAffiliation.telecom.value"
        label: "Phone"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "affiliate_org_email"
        path: "OrganizationAffiliation.telecom.value"
        label: "Email"

        path: "OrganizationAffiliation.active"
        label: "Active"

title: "Patients"

    id: section_patient

      # patient_name -> Patient.name.text existed, which real FHIR doesn't treat as satisfying

      # patient_name stays (AiEngine.vue's own patient grid/modal — a separate consumer of this
      # same form, unrelated to SPEC-24 — reads/writes it directly, so it can't be removed).
      # PatientBasicsHost.vue's own extract() derives patient_name from first+last automatically
      # so a patient is only ever typed once, not two redundant "name" prompts.

        path: "Patient.name.text"

        path: "Patient.name.given"
        label: "First Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true

        path: "Patient.name.family"
        label: "Last Name"

        path: "Patient.contact.name.text"
        label: "Emergency Contact Name"
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

        path: "Patient.contact.telecom.value"
        label: "Emergency Contact Phone"

      # real ABHA profile (found-by-mobile-search or created-via-Aadhaar, both against

      - id: "patient_mobile"

  # rejecting it. resourceType: Consent (a real, already-proven-compiling resourceType in this
  # pipeline — see section_consent in system-provider-composition-v1.yaml) is a genuine semantic

  # permit or deny... performance of one or more actions" — exactly what a facility admin does
  # here. `status`/`category` reuse Consent's own real leaf paths with real choices (status:
  # draft/active/rejected maps directly onto pending_admin_review/approved/rejected); the
  # remaining fields use other real, dictionary-confirmed Consent string leaves (verified against
  # data/graphs/consent.graph.json, not guessed) for the free-text details a chat card needs to
  # show. This record is NEVER run through ComprehensiveLocalExtractor or any conformance
  # validator — it exists purely so LhcFormHost.vue has something real to render, encoded/decoded
